set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- freeze uses a scoped builder or atomically transfers storage into consumed state.
- After freeze, read, write, and second-freeze operations fail deterministically.
- The immutable result cannot change through the former workspace.
- freezeCopy leaves the workspace reusable and isolates later writes.
- JVM and Scala.js state-machine tests generate set, read, freeze, freezeCopy, post-freeze access, and repeated-freeze sequences.
- Zero-copy transfer remains only if ownership is mechanically enforced.
set.title: Enforce consuming MutablePackedArray.freeze semantics
